definitions.full: H8335. shareth שָׁרֵת noun masculine religious ministry ; — הַשּׁ ׳כְּלֵי vessels of ministry in tabernacle Num 4:12 , temple 2Chr 24:14 . [ שָׁשָׂה ] see [ שׁסה ] Po`. I. שֵׁשׁ six , see שׁדשׁ . II. שֵׁשׁ see שַׁיִשׁ .

occurrences.englishText: “They shall take all the vessels of ministry with which they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a blue cloth, cover them with a covering of sealskin, and shall put them on the frame.

When they had finished, they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada, from which were made vessels for Yahweh’s house, even vessels with which to minister and to offer, including spoons and vessels of gold and silver. They offered burnt offerings in Yahweh’s house continually all the days of Jehoiada.
